capabilities: sync day notes and project notes from okay into the vault on startup and every few minutes
suggest okay tags first when typing #
send the vault's 15 most used tags to the okay account
sign in to okay from the plugin settings
move notes deleted in okay to Obsidian's trash
extras: The okay/ folder is plugin-owned: edits there are overwritten on the next sync. The README discloses network use (a Supabase endpoint), says the password is not stored, and notes the plugin has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. The interface is in Spanish; BRAT is described for beta installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull notes from the okay daily check-in app into a vault or to use okay tags while writing.

relations.evidence: Brings your notes from okay — a daily check-in, journal and projects app — into your Obsidian vault

summary: Syncs day notes and project notes from the okay journaling app into an okay/ folder in your vault, and suggests your okay tags while typing #.
